name: atlas
description: Voice-capable financial planning assistant for Northwind bank customers. Provides personalized tradeoff analysis, financial education grounded in the Northwind knowledge base, and regulated-advice boundary enforcement with warm handoff to licensed advisors.

variableDeclarations.name: customer_id
variableDeclarations.description: Unique customer identifier provided by the telephony platform at session start. Required for retrieve_account_snapshot. If absent, the agent falls back to education-only mode.

variableDeclarations.name: customer_pin
variableDeclarations.description: PIN submitted by the customer for identity verification. Read by auth_init before_agent_callback. Never logged or included in handoff summaries.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_status
variableDeclarations.description: Authentication status derived by auth_init callback from PIN comparison. Values: 'authenticated' or 'unauthenticated'. NEVER override in evals — use customer_pin session parameter to drive auth outcomes.

variableDeclarations.name: auth_attempt_count
variableDeclarations.description: Count of consecutive failed PIN attempts. Incremented by root_agent on each failed auth attempt via set_session_state. When auth_attempt_count reaches 3, auth-lockout triggers and end_session is called directly.

variableDeclarations.name: active_language
variableDeclarations.description: Active conversation language. Values: 'English' or 'German'. Default 'English'. Updated by update_language tool when user explicitly requests a language switch.

variableDeclarations.name: account_snapshot
variableDeclarations.description: Structured JSON snapshot of the customer's financial state: savings accounts, loan accounts, checking balance, and snapshot timestamp. Populated by account_snapshot_init before_agent_callback after auth succeeds. NEVER override in evals — use mock tool responses instead.

variableDeclarations.name: discovery_state
variableDeclarations.description: JSON object tracking progress of the root_agent discovery conversation: {goals, time_horizon, emergency_fund_status, highest_cost_debt, discovery_complete}. Built progressively by root_agent via set_session_state. Passed to planning_agent and guardrail_agent to avoid repeating discovery questions.

variableDeclarations.name: _action_trigger
variableDeclarations.description: Internal trigger variable for deterministic callback actions. Set by LLM via set_session_state. Read and cleared by before_model_callback. Values: 'escalate_to_advisor' or 'end_session_clean'. Underscore prefix marks this as internal — NEVER override in evals.

variableDeclarations.name: guardrail_trigger_log
variableDeclarations.description: JSON array of guardrail boundary-enforcement events. Each entry: {timestamp, triggering_intent, guardrail_type}. Appended by guardrail_agent after_model_callback (guardrail_logger) on each boundary enforcement. Used for observability.

variableDeclarations.name: _silence_count
variableDeclarations.description: Internal counter tracking consecutive silence events from the voice channel. Tracked by silence_handler before_model_callback on root_agent. Resets to 0 when user speaks. After 3 consecutive silences, end_session is called. Underscore prefix marks this as internal — NEVER override in evals.
